description: Lets the top bar's library menu (`ui/src/desktop.ts`) list the other libraries, open one, and go back to the libraries screen: `library_menu`, `library_switch` and `libraries_show` in src/main.rs. Switching closes this library's windows and server. `library_switch` takes a path from the page and opens it only if it is a data library. The `remote` block is REQUIRED for the same reason as in reveal-local-files.json, with the trailing `/**` load-bearing.
